subject: domain: make the transaction from `initStatsCtx` blocking gc (#53602)
summary: Change registers the stats-init session (`initStatsCtx`) as an internal session (with retry until SessionManager is ready) and removes it after `StatsHandle.InitStatsDone`, so GC min-start-ts reporting can observe the init-stats transaction and avoid GC advancing past it. Verified `InitStatsDone` is always closed via `Domain.initStats` defer (avoids goroutine leaks) and internal-session startTS collection ignores `ts==0` (so early registration before `BEGIN` doesn’t spuriously block GC). Later history refactors the init-stats/session handling (e.g. commit `57948d90e8` removes this block during a stats init redesign) with no indication of a Blocker/High correctness fix needed for this behavior.
